svg.text: K2b Pour about the lip, turn a rack pair, tumble a closed pair
X, Z and roll move together, so a vessel turns about a point in the air: its lip. Pairs of vessels or racks are turned as one closed unit.
pour: lip held 10 mm inside the target mouth for the whole tilt
rate closed-loop on the KH load cells or the jaw load pins (± 5 g)
Schnitzel: 160 mL fat = 3.4 mm, GA-36 racks Ø 235, 3 + 3 min
no hot liquid is ever inverted; flips at z ≤ 1200 over the hob
POUR ABOUT THE LIP: the pivot is virtual (software), not a cradle
the tilt rate follows the weight: slow at the end
nothing of the Wender is above the target
K2 needed a tip cradle for this; now it is software
SCHNITZEL: turned as a closed rack pair (GA-36)

g.text: after 3 min: upper rack set on; jaws take both ear pairs
lift, drain, turn — only the cutlets move, no fat in a joint
lowered: second side fries; the old lower rack is lifted off
cutlets float in 3.4 mm fat on the lower rack (5 mm feet)

svg.text: COATING: a closed pair of GN trays is tumbled by the roll
cutlets + 30 g flour inside, four turns; breaded ≤ 10 min before frying

g.text: 1/5 The jaws hold the source pot at its neck; X, Z and roll move together so that the pot turns about its own lip
2/5 The lip stays 10 mm inside the target mouth for the whole tilt; the KH load cells close the loop on the weight poured
3/5 Schnitzel: after 3 min the upper rack is set on the lower one; the jaws grip both ear pairs in their straight slots
4/5 Lift, hold 5 s so the fat drips back, roll 180°, lower: the cutlets lie raw side down; no fat ever sits in a rim joint
5/5 Coating: cutlets and flour in a closed pair of GN trays, tumbled four times by the roll
